question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Final verification: top customer with highest average monthly change and their name
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month, monthly_total,
           monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS change
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, AVG(ABS(mc.change)) AS avg_monthly_change
FROM monthly_changes mc
JOIN customer c ON mc.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE mc.change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
